note: Field motion (docs/specs/m2-play-calling-and-motion.md, Motion; Joseph's amendment: all 22 move from the snap). Designed starting values, tuned in playtest, none fitted. Speeds are yards per second of screen time at 1x, designed toward real top speeds (unverified: no primary source checked, spec revision 2026-11-14, R-Open 2); times are ms. Version 2 (revision 2026-11-14, real routes and slower pace): route, finish, plant, throw-hold, coverage, stalk and run-drift values. miss (amendment 2026-11-15, misses that read as misses): how an incompletion is drawn, designed. Version 3 (revision 2026-11-15, natural motion; schema change approved by Joseph 2026-11-15): natural, designed starting values for the per-player spread, the cruise wobble, the motion governor, the line hand fight, the idle sway and the ring while the ball is in the air. Version 4 (amendment 2026-11-15, kickoff return pass; schema change approved by Joseph 2026-11-15): kickReturn, designed starting values for the return wall, the blocks and the returner's cut. QB throw pace (2026-11-15, designed, display only, DECISIONS.md 'QB throw pace'): throwHold.leafMaxMs adds shortPass, screenPass and playAction at 600 ms (deepPass stays 1700, other classes keep maxMs 1200); the QB's pocket step up runs at pocket.pace x his top. Deeper drops (spec revision 2026-11-16, DECISIONS.md 'Deeper drops, shorter holds', designed): dropMs intermediatePass 1250 (was 950) and deepPass 1700 (was 1250), with leafMaxMs intermediatePass 900 and deepPass 1250 (was 1700), the same window ends. Version 5 (docs/specs/m2-player-reactions.md, player reactions; schema change approved by Joseph 2026-11-23): ratings.scrimmage, designed starting values for how each player's own ratings set his reaction to the read, his play-to-play variation, his pursuit, his coverage and blocks, his break pace, his break on a ball in the air and his get-off on scrimmage plays. Display only, none fitted, no primary source checked.

ratings.note: Joseph, 2026-11-15 (decision 12 reversed): a player's base ratings drive how he moves. Designed, not fitted. A rating at or below lo maps to the band's first value, at or above hi to its second, linearly between; 65 (the median of every position's distribution in data/players/distributions.json) maps to about the middle. speed scales top speed, agility scales accelMs, awareness adds to reactionMs and to the start after the snap. byPosition overrides the default band for one position. A player with no ratings moves at his position's values. Version 5 (docs/specs/m2-player-reactions.md, PR1 to PR16, designed, display only): on scrimmage plays (runs, passes, sacks, scrambles, tries from scrimmage) scrimmage.read replaces default.reactionMs, and its bands are not centred on 65: the reactionMs table value is about a 78-awareness defender. Kick plays, kneels and spikes keep default.reactionMs. scrimmage.by names the rating that drives each effect, by position. Each scrimmage pair is [value at lo, value at hi] and adds nothing for a player without that rating. read: a defender's reaction to the read is max(minMs, reactionMs[position] + defenseMs + his spread + varyMs x v), the floor applied last so a higher rating is never later; an unnamed offensive mark's is the same with offenseMs added to 0; and an unnamed DL releases max(0, releaseMs + varyMs x v) after the line's release, or the key before the ball's ring would push him where he stands engaged, whichever comes first (never before the line's release; the pair's hand fight still ends at the line's release). v is in [-1, 1] from a hash of his id and the game state before the snap, never the calls or the result. The engine's tackler leaves his unnamed track at the read plus his reaction when his run to the tackle allows it, earlier when it does not, and no later than the key before the ring would push him. pursuit: leadMs and leadVaryMs x v are added to pursuit.leadMs and kept between leadMinMs and leadMaxMs, and turnShare scales natural.lateralAccel and pursuit.turnDegPerS. man, stalk, biteShare and breakPaceShare set his man trail and cushion, his stalk lag, his play-action bite and his pace through a break, and stalk.clearYards is how near a man running at a rated blocker comes before he is backed off (at most stalk.contactYards). air and getOff are read by later slices of that spec.

moments.note: DESIGN.md Prime Time, Motion, Moments (Joseph approved the holds 2026-11-15). Designed pacing, not fitted: each moment's minimum whistle hold at 1x in ms (the hold is the larger of the play's own and this; 2x halves it; Space ends it), the gain from scrimmage that makes a big play, and the bug's one first-down flash in ms (mirrored in styles.css --first-down-flash).

kickReturn.note: Kickoff return pass (docs/specs/m2-play-calling-and-motion.md, KR1 to KR9), designed starting values, tuned in playtest, none fitted. Display only: the engine decides the dead spot, the returner, the tackler and the outcome. Yards in the kicking team's frame; paces are shares of the player's top speed. During the hang each blocker sets up toward his lane in a wall wallDepthYards in front of the landing spot (two rows wallRowYards apart, lanes spread over wallWidthYards, wider than laneSpreadYards, KR3's least span, so the span holds when an edge man is named), at setupPace, moving at least setupYards. From the catch he meets a coverage man at blockPace, in contact contactYards apart (engaged within engageYards), and the pair drifts together at blockDriftYps (yd/s, eased in over blockEaseMs) to the whistle; a blocker with nobody to block leads the carrier by leadYards at leadPace. A block is planned only with at least minBlockMs left and only where the coverage man stays corridorMarginYards outside the carrier's corridor; unblocked coverage pursues a point containYards outside that corridor on its own side of the carrier, never the carrier himself (only the engine's tackler comes to the ball). On returns of cutMinReturnYards or more the returner runs at least upfieldYards straight, on until just after the first block that puts more blocks on one side when the return is long enough, then cuts cutYards toward that side (the id hash's on a tie) over cutDepthYards, its corners run at cutPace and rounded so the turn's lateral acceleration is cutLateralAccel (yd/s^2, under N2's breakLateralAccel) at his speed on the screen clock: the play's fillet radius at least, cutRadiusYards at most. behindToleranceYards and whistleWindowMs are the KR3 and KR4 limits. Where he cuts: the blocks are planned once, against the straight lane widened by cutYards past upfieldYards, so they are the same whichever way he cuts; his corner comes one of cutLagsMs after a planned block, at the first where the blocks on one side outnumber the other over stableMs either side of readLeadMs before the corner (counted as KR4 reads a contact, on the plan's keys; a blocker within deadbandYards of the catch x makes the count unreadable). With none, he cuts lateCutMs after the first block, to the id hash's side. cutDeg and headingMs are KR6's cut: a heading change of cutDeg or more, headings over headingMs.
